title: 第701章 再次背锅的方师兄第700章 小影有心魔了
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
坐在床上，龙涛闭目内视，感受着周身穴窍的状态。大部分穴位已被带有星辰之力的灵气充填、浸润，经脉像是被水反复冲刷过的河道，灵力运转起来比“点星”之前顺畅了好几成。
只剩下最后几处穴位还空着，等它们也淬炼完毕，就可以着手冲击十二层了。
练气十二层啊，对于五灵根杂役弟子出身的他来说，这曾经是一个需要仰望的境界。
别看九霞天宗是天下有数的大派，可大部分弟子其实也就那么回事，还是比较摆烂的，很多几十岁的人都还在练气期混着呢，特别是练气七层的那个“阴风劫”，对很多弟子来说，是一个大坎。
不少刚入门时被认为有前途的新人，后来都意外的卡在了那一步，甚至在经历过一次失败后，对阴风产生了恐惧，彻底摆烂停留在六层的人，一直都大有人在。
但反过来说，能够突破七层的人，那都是完成了考验的，除非之后遇到什么事故或霉运，不然基本都是能稳筑基的。
当然，龙涛偏偏就是那个会遇到事故的人，也许到时候，他会成为宗门这个世代，唯一一个卡在练气十二层不筑基的人，那也算是个大笑话了。
但不管怎么样，能到达十二层，还是值得恭喜一下自己的，他甚至已经在脑子里排练过几次，等到哪天站在那些大课长老面前，理直气壮地开口，
“怎么样，长老？当年坐在最后一排的那个五灵根废物，如今也是练气十二层了。”
此刻的他，全身心的内视着自己的经脉和神魂，这种专注力也是让他觉得不同于凡人的一点。
连续几个小时都能专注于一件事，前世的自己要是有这份专注的话，也不至于每次背单词，都得从a、b、a、n、d、o、n，abandon开始了。
……
专心修炼了两天后，龙涛终于又走出家门，打算去天枢阁报到了，他估摸着，最多一个月，自己就能突破，浑身是满满的干劲。
“哥，你终于出来了啊？”
龙汐今天放假，正骑着聆岚在院子里打转，一见他出门就跑了过来。
“嗯。”龙涛四下看了一眼，“爹娘和刘叔呢？”
“我正要告诉你呢，奶奶来了，爹娘他们先过去了。”
“奶奶来了？！什么时候？”
“好像是两三天前吧，不过她这次来还是做生意的，所以头两天一直在忙，今天才通知我们。”
“这样啊，那你也不过去看看奶奶。”

“我倒想去啊，但你在修炼，家里总得有个人啊，再说了，奶奶明天会会亲自过来，所以也不急的。”
龙涛点了点头，看来明天又得请假了。
“行，那你和聆岚玩吧，我先去主峰了。”
……
驾着怜星号来到主峰，龙涛立刻就在侧殿旁边的花园看到了熟人。
方师兄！
不过他也有些奇怪，方师兄这阵子可是天下的焦点，名人中的名人，借用天雷和外魔，以肉身对抗雷劫的壮举，到现在都是酒楼茶馆里，说书先生换着花样说的新流行。
按理说，这会儿他应该躲在家里，一边稳固修为，一边躲清静才对啊，怎么会到主峰来的
“方师兄！”
content_en:
Sitting on the bed, Long Tao closed his eyes and looked inside, feeling the state of the acupoints all over his body. Most of the acupuncture points have been filled and infiltrated by spiritual energy with the power of the stars. The meridians are like rivers washed repeatedly by water. The spiritual energy runs several times smoother than before "Pointing Stars".
Only the last few acupuncture points are still empty. After they are tempered, you can start to attack the twelfth floor.
The twelfth level of Qi training, for him who was born as a handyman disciple of the Five Spiritual Roots, this was once a realm that he needed to look up to.
Even though Jiuxia Tianzong is one of the most powerful sects in the world, most of its disciples are just that, and they are still relatively poor. Many people in their decades are still messing around in the Qi training period, especially the "Yinfeng Tribulation" at the seventh level of Qi training, which is a big hurdle for many disciples.
Many newcomers who were considered promising when they first started were unexpectedly stuck at that step. Even after experiencing a failure, they developed a fear of the evil wind and completely destroyed the people who stayed on the sixth floor. There are always many people.
But on the other hand, those who can break through the seventh level have completed the test. Unless they encounter any accidents or bad luck later, they can basically build a stable foundation.
Of course, Long Tao is the one who will encounter accidents. Maybe by then, he will become the only person in this generation of the sect who is stuck at the twelfth level of Qi training without building the foundation. That would be a big joke.
But no matter what, it was worth congratulating himself for reaching the twelfth floor. He had even rehearsed it several times in his mind, so that one day he would stand in front of those senior lecturers and speak confidently,
"How's it going, elder? That five-spirit-root waste who was sitting in the last row is now at the twelfth level of Qi training."
At this moment, he was looking at his meridians and soul with all his heart. This concentration also made him feel different from ordinary people.
I can focus on one thing for several hours in a row. If I had this focus in my previous life, I wouldn't have to start from a, b, a, n, d, o, n, abandon every time I memorize a word.
…
After concentrating on training for two days, Long Tao finally walked out of the house again and planned to report to Tianshu Pavilion. He estimated that he would be able to break through in a month at most, and he was full of energy.
"Brother, are you finally out?"
Long tide was on vacation today and was riding Linglan around in the yard. When he saw him going out, he ran over.
"Yes." Long Tao glanced around, "Where are my parents and Uncle Liu?"
"I was just about to tell you that grandma is here, and my parents went there first."
"Grandma is here?! When?"
"It seems to have been two or three days ago, but she came here for business, so she was busy for the first two days and only informed us today."
"That's right, then why don't you go over and see grandma."
"I would like to go, but since you are practicing, there must be someone at home. Besides, grandma will come over in person tomorrow, so there is no rush."
Long Tao nodded. It seemed that he would have to ask for leave again tomorrow.
"Okay, then you and Linglan can play, I'll go to the main peak first."
…
Driving the Lianxing to the main peak, Long Tao immediately saw an acquaintance in the garden next to the side hall.
Senior Brother Fang!
However, he was also a little surprised. Senior Brother Fang is the focus of the world these days. Celebrities among celebrities, borrowing thunder from the sky and external demons to physically resist thunder tribulations, are now a new trend in restaurants and teahouses, and storytellers tell them in different ways.
Logically speaking, he should be hiding at home at the moment, stabilizing his cultivation while staying quiet. How did he come to the main peak?
"Senior Brother Fang!"
